dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Peter Parker is on the at-risk list due to medical concerns. Peter Parker is a friendly cat who was surrendered due owner unable to address their medical condition. We have assessed that Peter Parker has vestibular disease (head tilt), but the underlying cause is unknown. Peter Parker would benefit from a consultation with a neurologist and may need advanced imaging to determine the cause. Peter Parker has allowed all handling and seeks attention during their exams.
dog.name: Peter Parker
